entities.summary: Florid Bulyakov (b. 1948-02-23, Bolshiye Shady) was a journalist or media commentator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Bolshiye Shady. Known in the fields of poets & playwrights.
